title: AI for All: Identifying AI incidents Related to Diversity and Inclusion
benchmark_measurement: Identification and frequency analysis of AI incidents involving bias or discrimination based on religion, as one of several diversity attributes.
base_benchmarks: AI, Algorithmic, and Automation Incidents and Controversies (AIAAIC)
findings: The study identified religion as a significant diversity attribute where AI-related discrimination occurs. The analysis found 19 incidents related to religion in the AIID database and 14 in the AIAAIC database. A specific example of religious bias was an AI system assigning higher toxicity scores to content involving 'Christian' phrases.
